Greetings Voaters!

I'm an Ottawa base entrepreneur and animal lover and I've been working with a small team to plan a new dog park in the south end of the city which would feature pet friendly pools and ponds.

We'd love to hear your opinion on the matter, and have created an 8 question survey to help collect information:

https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/9HHGWJR

The current design proposals include:

The facility willl act as a hub for (predominantly) dog activity while some other animals may find use from the location and would be welcomed. Abbey Manor 2.0 will host an indoor and outdoor dog-park (including an indoor and outdoor pond, splash/spray area, and agility stations), indoor swimming pools intended for single (or small groups of) dog (and human) use, a pet food and accessory store, a pet grooming facility, a veterinary service facility, an animal boarding facility (including day-care services), and an animal rescue/shelter. The location will also be home to the Skunk Tail, the first real roller coaster designed for dogs (and their humans).

Outdoor (3 season) Park

The outdoor park is comprised of a completely fenced in, 3-4 acre, area with the main building on its perimeter, a circuit path following the perimeter fence, two main walking paths with minor offshoot paths (providing access to different areas of the park), two additionally fenced areas containing the swimming pond and splash/spray areas, three open areas (designated for small, large, and all dogs), an agility course, as well as multiple general play stations equipped with fun and challenging toys.

Note that benches and drinking stations will be provided at regular intervals along main pathways. Perimeter fence The perimeter fence will intersect with the ground and have a height of six feet to ensure dogs of all sizes are safe within the park. The fence will have multiple double gated entry/exit points.

Pathways

The perimeter path will follow the contours of the perimeter fence at a distance of 15-20 feet and have a width of 10-15 feet. One large pathway (width of 15-20 feet) will bisect the park from entrance to rear, providing a quick route to all destinations within the park as well as an ideal walking path for the social dog. The large path will have two main paths (width of 10-15 feet) that intersect it, and connect in at least one location to the perimeter path.

Offshoot paths (width of 8-10 feet) will lead to any important park areas that are not directly attached to the main paths Rest & Water Stations

Park style benches and water fountains for both dog and human use will be provided at all major park stations, and where main pathways intersect.

Swimming Pond

The outdoor swimming pond will be a 500-750 square foot, slightly irregular, oblong water body with depths reaching no more than 60 inches at its center. It will be filtered and sanitized by a combination of natural methods and UV treatment of the water. The entire areas will be surrounded by an 8’ fence which meets the ground, and has no less than two double gated entry/exit points.

Splash/Spray Pad

The outdoor splash/spray pad will be a 60 foot square fenced in area with two double gated entry points. The splash zone will be a 40 foot by 10 foot pool with a maximum depth of 1 foot and a gradually slope around its entire edge for easy entry. The spray pad is a series of durable hoses and padded poles which emit a variety of streams and mists as well as a 20 foot wide 4 foot tall water slide with a combination of dog appropriate ramp and stair options to ensure a safe trip to the sliding platform.

Agility Course

The agility course will be comprised of two main courses (beginner and intermediate/expert) and individual training stations. Training stations and courses will include multi-level jumps, varying length tunnels, dog-walks, A-frames, weaves, as well as a teeter totter and stairs/slide.

Play Stations

Small sections off of the main (and other paths) will be cleared and equipped with engaging apparatus for solo and group play such as rope tug, balance platform, and puzzle stations.

Main Fields

The park will have three main fields to best accommodate all dogs. One field will be gears towards smaller dogs and those who require gentler play, one for all dogs and general exercise, as well as one for larger dogs and more active/physical play.

Indoor Park

The indoor park is a ½-1 acre facility housed inside of an air-supported (or more permanent) dome attached to the main building featuring a perimeter path, half-sized splash pad, and a small oasis (comprised of a natural appearing 250-500 square foot swimming pool with gradual entry from one side and small water-falls and jumping platforms on the other), and agility course.

Other Facilities

Indoor Swimming Pools

The facility will house ten to twenty 10 foot by 20 foot pools with a maximum depth of 6 feet and a regulation height dock jumping platforms at one end as well as easy entry stairs or ramps at each corner.

Fitness Center

The fitness center will consist of five 15 foot by 15 foot rooms and equipped with a variety of dog exercise and fitness equipment including a balancing platform, treadmill, exercise balls, and weighted vests.

Veterinary Office

The veterinary office will be equipped with a waiting room, 3 exam rooms, an operating room, a small lab, and supporting facilities to house up to 10 cats and 5 dogs during visits that require a longer stay.

Animal Food/Accessory Store

The store will have 5000-10000 square feet of floor space with equal amounts of space available for storage. The location will specialize in canine diet’s and exercise needs.

Grooming Facility

The grooming facility will be capable of service small-large animals, with 5 grooming tables and bathing stations. Boarding Facility & Dog Day Care The boarding facility will be equipped to handle up to 30 dogs at a time on an over-night basis, and will be capable of providing day-care services for up to an additional 20 dogs.

Animal Rescue/Shelter

The animal shelter will be equipped to home up to 20 animals and will strive to rehabilitate and rehome all animals.
